results.gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', o.orderDate) AS year, strftime('%m', o.orderDate) AS month, SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) AS total_sales FROM orders o JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber GROUP BY strftime('%Y', o.orderDate), strftime('%m', o.orderDate) ORDER BY year, month LIMIT 500

results.question: ลูกค้าที่มียอดชำระเงินรวมสูงกว่าค่าเฉลี่ย
results.gold_sql: SELECT c.customerName, SUM(p.amount) AS total_paid FROM customers c JOIN payments p ON c.customerNumber = p.customerNumber GROUP BY c.customerName HAVING SUM(p.amount) > (SELECT AVG(total) FROM (SELECT SUM(amount) AS total FROM payments GROUP BY customerNumber)) LIMIT 500
results.pred_sql:
SELECT
  c.customerName,
  SUM(p.amount) AS total_payment
FROM customers AS c
JOIN payments AS p
  ON c.customerNumber = p.customerNumber
GROUP BY
  c.customerNumber
HAVING
  total_payment > (
    SELECT
      AVG(total)
    FROM (
      SELECT
        SUM(amount) AS total
      FROM payments
      GROUP BY
        customerNumber
    )
  )
LIMIT 500

results.question: ยอดขายต่อพนักงานของแต่ละสำนักงาน
results.gold_sql: SELECT o.city AS office, COUNT(DISTINCT e.employeeNumber) AS employees, ROUND(SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) / COUNT(DISTINCT e.employeeNumber), 2) AS sales_per_employee FROM offices o JOIN employees e ON o.officeCode = e.officeCode LEFT JOIN customers c ON e.employeeNumber = c.salesRepEmployeeNumber LEFT JOIN orders ord ON c.customerNumber = ord.customerNumber LEFT JOIN orderdetails od ON ord.orderNumber = od.orderNumber GROUP BY o.officeCode LIMIT 500
results.pred_sql:
SELECT
  offices.officeCode,
  SUM(orderdetails.priceEach * orderdetails.quantityOrdered) AS sales_per_employee
FROM offices
JOIN employees
  ON offices.officeCode = employees.officeCode
JOIN orders
  ON employees.employeeNumber = orders.customerNumber
JOIN orderdetails
  ON orders.orderNumber = orderdetails.orderNumber
GROUP BY
  offices.officeCode
ORDER BY
  sales_per_employee DESC
LIMIT 500

results.question: สัดส่วนยอดขาย (เปอร์เซ็นต์) ของแต่ละ Product Line
results.gold_sql: SELECT p.productLine, ROUND(SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(quantityOrdered * priceEach) FROM orderdetails), 2) AS pct FROM products p JOIN orderdetails od ON p.productCode = od.productCode GROUP BY p.productLine ORDER BY pct DESC LIMIT 500
results.pred_sql:
SELECT
  pl.productLine,
  SUM(od.priceEach * od.quantityOrdered) / (
    SELECT
      SUM(priceEach * quantityOrdered)
    FROM orderdetails
  ) * 100 AS sales_ratio
FROM orderdetails AS od
JOIN products AS p
  ON od.productCode = p.productCode
JOIN productlines AS pl
  ON p.productLine = pl.productLine
GROUP BY
  pl.productLine
LIMIT 500
